The scripts commit was therefore inferred: 63ac3265b0 (2026-10-10) is the only master commit between 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-19, so the 2026-10-17 20:51 build used that tree. (4) opencore-amr is given as the official v0.1.6 release tarball (commit 7dba8c3 carries tag v0.1.6), not a byte-for-byte git export. soxr and mingw-w64 (SourceForge git) use GitHub mirrors with the same SHA. (7) The git archive endpoints (GitHub codeload, GitLab, gitiles) are generated on demand and send no Content-Length. Sizes were measured by streaming. Archives over 20 MB were aborted and carry bytes=0 with 'size not measured', so total bytes understates the real size. Generated archives can differ byte-for-byte over time, and no checksums are recorded.
